README.md.description: Repository overview, directory layout, metadata rules, and manifest workflow instructions.

config/file-metadata.json.description: Authoritative repository-relative file descriptions required for manifest generation.

src/generate-manifest.js.description: Validates descriptive metadata and generates the tracked-file inventory manifest.

.github/workflows/update-manifest.yml.description: GitHub Actions workflow that regenerates and commits the repository manifest.

src/issue-command.js.description: Executes validated commands and returns structured results without publishing.

src/render-command.js.description: Imported StateMachines command-result Markdown renderer and chunking utility.

src/command-parser.js.description: Parses owner-authorized issue command comments and passes validated command envelopes to the downstream executor.

src/command-runner.js.description: Executes exactly one selected command and writes one result before terminating.

.github/workflows/commandline-issue.yml.description: Routes authorized issue comments through parser and runner.

src/command-catalog.json.description: Imported GitHub operation catalog used by command executor.

src/publish-results.js.description: Renders queued execution results and publishes comments to the originating issue.

src/command-workflow.js.description: Workflow coordinator invokes one runner process per ordinal nonce and accumulates each result.
